rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Speaker read to the House a letter from the President, signed 'Thabo Mbeki'. It says the ANC leadership had told him it had decided to recall him and that he had therefore decided to resign as President, 'effective upon receiving your advice that Parliament has finalised this matter'.

locator.heading: RESIGNATION OF PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC (Announcement)

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: In the same letter Mbeki recalls that the Assembly elected him on 23 April 2004 and that on 27 April 2004 he took the oath of office as President.

locator.heading: RESIGNATION OF PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC (Announcement)

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Chief Whip of the Majority Party moved without notice that the House agree that the President's resignation take effect on 25 September 2008. The FF Plus objected, so under the Rules the motion became a notice of motion for the next day's Order Paper.

locator.heading: ACCEPTANCE OF RESIGNATION OF PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC (Draft Resolution)
